LINEWORK: the broken_dry treatment is plainly present at full resolution, contradicting "continuous and clean at 4x". In P7000271 the jaw contour thins and drops out entirely along the left jaw and again near the chin, the neck edge is carried by tone with no ink at all, the finger and knuckle strokes on both hands are dashed with tapered dry terminations and visible gaps, and the hair breaks into separated dry wisps. The reviewer was reading a downsampled tile where sub-pixel gaps close up.

Note the garment is near-black in all three seeds, which makes silhouette ink continuity unassessable on the jacket itself — the judgeable linework is on skin, and there it clearly breaks.

case_151:
elastic_pressure + airy_pastel + broad_blended_plane: airy_pastel and broad_blended_plane are strongly visible (pale pink/mint/lavender at low contrast, broad soft planes), but elastic_pressure is unreadable - at 6x the render is lineless gouache with silhouette and collar formed by paint edges, so a thin pressure-varying contour cannot be confirmed or ruled out at this density. -- overturned at full resolution: Thumbnail artifact — the defect does not survive full resolution.

Resolution: manifest alias `case_151` = style_id `linework_coloring_elastic_pressure_airy_pastel_broad_blended_plane_controlled_rim_complete_line_color`, which maps to scorecard rows P7000451 (seed 1001), P7000452 (seed 2002), P7000453 (seed 3003). All three 1024x1024 renders inspected full-size plus native-pixel crops of face, eye, neckline, and garment.

elastic_pressure IS readable at 1:1 on every seed; it is only the 6x contact-sheet downscale that erases it. The strokes that carry it are 1-4 px wide, so they average away into the gouache planes at thumbnail scale. Concretely:
- Upper lash line (clearest evidence, /tmp/.../eye453.png at 8x NEAREST on P7000453 crop 540,300-700,380): a discrete dark stroke that enters thin at the inner corner, swells to maximum width over the iris, then tapers to a hairline point that overshoots the outer canthus. A second, finer crease line above it tapers the same way. Same behaviour on both eyes of all three seeds.
- Mouth: the lip-closure line thickens to a dark accent at one corner and narrows toward centre (strongly on P7000451 and P7000452).
- Nostrils: short curved tapering strokes rather than blobs (P7000453).
- Garment, so the linework is not confined to the face: P7000451's V-neck carries a lavender/pink contour that is widest at the neck and thins downward, with a pale blue lapel line; P7000453's crew neckline is a blue-grey contour that is thicker on the left shoulder and thins across to the right, plus a tapering vertical chest seam line. Hair is rendered as wedge strokes, thick at root and tapering to points.

So the "lineless gouache, silhouette formed by paint edges" read is wrong at full res: there are true drawn contours whose width varies with weight/light, exactly as elastic_pressure specifies. The two co-factors flagged as visible in the thumbnail remain visible and are unaffected — airy_pastel (pale pink/mint/lavender/butter at low contrast, protected whites, black hair as the grounding dark) and broad_blended_plane (large soft-transition planes on cheek, jaw, chest with silhouette edges kept crisp).

Saturation was not the concern, but checked for completeness: tests/reports/phase7_linework_coloring_v2/saturation_screen.json groups by palette family, and the airy_pastel group (42 items, median 0.0839, range 0.0672-0.1085) reports outlier_count 0, so this item is not a saturation outlier within its own group either.

No seed disagreement; nothing to hold on.

case_241:
rounded_soft + deep_jewel + soft_two_band: real defect - garment is pure black with no jewel hue in any seed (garment median S 0.123-0.172); rounded_soft smooth turns and the feathered two-band face shading are both fine, so the coloring value alone fails. -- overturned at full resolution: test_id P7000721/P7000722/P7000723 (style_id linework_coloring_rounded_soft_deep_jewel_soft_two_band_controlled_rim_complete_line_color). All three seeds inspected at 1024x1024, plus 5x-brightened crops of the garment mass.

The literal observation is true: the garment is a genuinely neutral black in every seed. Masking dark garment pixels (V 0.05-0.25, y>760) gives mean RGB chroma of only 2.2-3.8/255, and the tiny residual chroma sits entirely in the 0-30 deg warm band (hair bleed), with zero pixels in any green/teal/blue/violet jewel band. So this is not a thumbnail artifact of the garment reading.

But it is not an item-level coloring failure:

1. The saturation screen contradicts the cited evidence. deep_jewel group median 0.1628, range 0.1107-0.2117, outlier_count 0. Recomputing whole-image mean saturation myself puts case_241 at 0.1674 vs a group median of 0.1682 - rank 21 of 43, dead center. The reviewer's "garment median S 0.123-0.172" is group-typical saturation, not a deficit; per the screen's own rule that is not evidence.

2. The nearest siblings render identically and were not flagged. case_242 (P7000724, rounded_soft + deep_jewel + soft_two_band, differing only in accent_light, the axis the sheet verdict explicitly EXCLUDES) is the same pure-black garment with no jewel hue. case_094 (broken_dry + deep_jewel + soft_two_band + controlled_rim) is likewise all-black. Quantifying jewel-hue presence (dark pixels, S>0.20, cool hue) across all 43 deep_jewel cases shows the metric splits by LINEWORK, not coloring: all 12 angular_precise cases score 0.024-0.182 (e.g. case_007 has a visible deep-green lapel and plum inner), while 30 of the 43 - essentially every rounded_soft, broken_dry, selective_edge and crisp_uniform case - score <=0.0006. case_241 scores 0.0000, indistinguishable from its accepted peers. Holding case_241 would require holding 30 of 43 deep_jewel cases.

3. The catalog prompt for deep_jewel reads "filled with deep jewel color separated by dark neutrals and small high-value accents" - a dark-neutral garment mass is inside the spec, not a violation of it.

The reviewer's own note already conceded rounded_soft smooth turns and the feathered soft_two_band face shading are correct, and the controlled rim on the shadow-side silhouette is present. What remains is a rig-wide deep_jewel weakness under non-angular linework, not a defect attributable to this case. Verdict: does not hold.
case_271: selective_edge + deep_jewel + fine_tonal_hatching: real defect - deep_jewel absent, seed 2002 rendering near-greyscale (garment median S 0.120-0.178), and no hatch strokes are evident in the smooth painterly folds; only selective_edge is expressed, with forms completed by colour boundaries. -- overturned at full resolution: Thumbnail artifact on both counts. (1) Hatching: at full resolution all three seeds (P7000811/1001, P7000812/2002, P7000813/3003) show clear fine tonal hatching concentrated in occluded folds — parallel hatch fields across the waistband and skirt planes and short stroke bundles at sleeve creases in seed 1001, the same on shoulder/sleeve/skirt in seed 2002, and at 4x with a gamma lift the sleeve shadows resolve into discrete directional dry-brush stroke clusters rather than smooth painterly gradients. Skin keeps only sparse hatching on hands and jaw, exactly as the resolved prompt specifies. The strokes are low-contrast dark-on-dark and disappear when downsampled into a contact-sheet cell, which is why the sheet read as smooth. (2) Saturation: saturation_screen.json groups on coloring; deep_jewel has median 0.1628, min 0.1107, max 0.2117 and outlier_count 0 (deviation 0.5 → threshold ~0.081). The reviewer's own cited garment range 0.120-0.178 straddles its own group median, so it is typical for deep_jewel, not below it. A sibling in the same deep_jewel + fine_tonal_hatching + reflected_color family (P7000719) renders an identically black garment on the same warm-grey ground, and the item spec itself calls for "deep jewel color separated by dark neutrals and small high-value accents" — the very dark warm-chromatic garment mass (chromatic pixels at V~0.02-0.04) plus reflected warm accents on jaw, hands and lower folds satisfies that. selective_edge is expressed. No genuine defect visible at full resolution.
